phase1.title: Tarot Deck
phase1.description: 78 beautifully illustrated cards featuring a complete redesign around 5 elements: Aether, Air, Fire, Water, and Earth. The Major Arcana reimagined as an inward journey.

phase2.title: Illustrated Guidebook
phase2.description: A comprehensive guide exploring the philosophy, symbolism, and deeper meanings behind each card. Includes spreads, rituals, and practical applications.

phase3.title: Card Game
phase3.description: An innovative strategy game built on the new deck system, allowing players to experience tarot wisdom through interactive gameplay and exploration.

daily.title: Your Daily Spread
daily.description: Draw cards for reflection and activation—connect with your inner wisdom
daily.intro: Take a moment to contemplate the card drawn for you. Visualize, breathe into, or speak aloud its meaning. If it doesn't resonate, simply draw another until you find your match.

scrollMaze.title: Coming Soon: ScrollMaze
scrollMaze.subtitle: Transform the Sunlight Tarot into a roguelike adventure game
scrollMaze.feature1Desc: Lay out cards face-down to create an ever-changing maze. Flip cards to reveal rooms, roll dice to determine encounters.
scrollMaze.feature2Desc: Battle monsters using the five-element system. Water douses fire, fire evaporates water - master the cycles to win.
scrollMaze.feature3Desc: Understanding each card's meaning gives you tactical advantage. Learn tarot through engaging gameplay, not memorization.
